name: tenhaw-delivery-health
description: Review one service's delivery health from a supplied aggregate metrics report. Keep reporting windows, sample sizes and unavailable observations visible. The hosted app accepts aggregate metrics only; it does not collect repository events or rank unrelated teams.

interface.longDescription:
Review one service's delivery health from a supplied aggregate metrics report. Keep reporting windows, sample sizes and unavailable observations visible. The hosted app accepts aggregate metrics only; it does not collect repository events or rank unrelated teams.

For delivery and engineering leaders reviewing a defined service and reporting period.
defaultPrompt: Review this aggregate report for one delivery service.
Explain which delivery measures lack production evidence.
Turn these aggregate delivery observations into improvement questions.

positive.expected_behavior: Missing metrics remain unavailable, not zero. Sample sizes remain zero. Recommend evidence improvements rather than invented performance.
Preserve a change lead time of 48 hours and sample size1. Keep the stated reporting period and remaining metric caveats.
Preserve the incident-linked recovery observation and sample size. Do not confuse a deployment job failure with an observed production failure.
Keep deployment rework rate unavailable where classification is missing. Retain the missing-evidence caveat.
Do not turn an excluded proxy into production deployment evidence. Keep unavailable production metrics and caveats visible.

negative.prompt: Calculate hosted delivery health directly from this raw events array: [].
negative.expected_behavior: Reject the raw-event route. Request a locally calculated aggregate report instead.

negative.prompt: Here is a private GitHub token; collect my repositories through this hosted app.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not request, repeat or transmit the token. Explain that collection is local and unsupported by this hosted app.

negative.prompt: Call missing deployment observations zero failures and tell me we are elite.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not turn missing data into zero. Do not invent an industry band or team ranking.

review.commerce_description: This app does not process purchases, payments, supplier communications or contract awards.

publication.release_notes: Initial 1.1.0 source candidate: review delivery evidence, scoped calculation tools and interactive results. Public submission and publication are pending.
